line.a_wyscig.text: Today is the great forest race! There are medals for the winners.

line.a_start.text: On your marks, get set, go!

line.a_zajac_wygral.text: Bunny won! He's the biggest, so he's first!

line.a_nie_najwiekszy.text: Mole, in a race it doesn't matter who is the biggest.

line.a_pierwszy.text: First is the one who reached the finish first. Then second, third, and at the end the last.

line.a_kto_ostatni.text: And now point to the one who came in last.

line.a_kto_ostatni_nie.text: That one was faster. Who arrived at the very end?

line.a_ostatnia.text: Mouse came in last. Last, but she reached the finish too!

line.a_podium.text: Onto the podium! Put the first at the very top, on the one. The second on the two, the third on the three.

line.a_podium_nie.text: That's not his place. Who came first, second, third?

line.a_podium_nie.sowa.text: That's not his place. Who came first, second, third?

line.a_podium_nie.kret.text: That's not his place. Who came first, second, third?

line.a_podium_ok.text: First, second and third on the podium. Well done, everyone!

line.b_zjezdzalnia.text: The playground! There's a queue for the slide. But who is first here?

line.b_od_przodu.text: In a queue we count from the front, from the arrow: first, second, third, fourth.

line.b_trzeci.text: Point to the one who is third in the queue.

line.b_trzeci_nie.text: Count from the arrow: first, second, third.

line.b_zjezdza.text: Mouse is first, so she slides down! And then she goes to the end of the queue.

line.b_kto_teraz.text: Point to the one who is first now.

line.b_kto_teraz_nie.text: Look who is standing by the arrow now.

line.b_teraz_pierwszy.text: Yes, now Bunny is first! When the first one leaves, everybody moves up.

line.p_start.text: Let's practise: first, second, third, last! I have five games.

line.p_drugi.text: Point to the one who is second in the queue.

line.p_drugi_nie.text: We count from the arrow: first, second.

line.p_ostatni.text: Point to the one who is last in the queue.

line.p_ostatni_nie.text: The last one stands at the very end, furthest from the arrow.

line.p_wyscig.text: One more race! Watch carefully who gets there first.

line.p_podium.text: Put the winners on the podium: first, second and third.

line.p_medale.text: The gold medal is for first place, silver for second, bronze for third. Point to the medal for the second.

line.p_medale_nie.text: That one is for another place. The second gets silver.

line.p_srebrny.text: Yes, the silver medal for second place!

line.p_trzeci.text: Duckling wants to stand third in the queue. Drag her to the third place.

line.p_trzeci_nie.text: That's not the third place. Count from the arrow: first, second, third.

line.h_zabawki.text: We're at my home! Now my toys have a race, and medals after, just like in the forest!

line.h_rodzice.text: Race your parents to the door. Then say who was first, who was second and who was last!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for a wonderful race! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the gold medal from the forest race. We got it when we learnt who is first, second and last.

line.a_nie_widzialem.text: Oh my, they ran so fast and so close together! So who really got there first? I didn't see.

line.a_zdjecie.text: I took a photo of the finish! The photo will show us who touched the white line first.

line.a_zdjecie_kto.text: Point to the one who touches the finish line first in the photo.

line.a_zdjecie_nie.text: Look at the white finish line. Whose nose is already touching it?

line.a_zdjecie_tak.text: The photo showed it all: Hedgehog first, Bunny right behind him, and then Duckling.

line.a_po_wyscigu.text: We'll give out the medals on the podium! While everything gets ready, let's go to the playground.

line.b_ceremonia.text: The podium is ready! Let's go and give out the medals.

line.c_podium_miejsce.text: How lovely it is here! Colourful flags, flowers and a real podium for the winners!

line.c_medale.text: And here are the medals! Gold is for first place, silver for second, and bronze for third.

line.c_zloty.text: The gold medal for the first, for Hedgehog!

line.c_srebrny.text: The silver medal is for second place. Point to the one who gets it.

line.c_srebrny_nie.text: That one is on another step. The second stands on the two.

line.c_brazowy.text: And the bronze medal goes to the third, Duckling!

line.c_koniec.text: Hooray! Now everyone knows who was first, second and third. And it wasn't the biggest who won, but the fastest!

line.a_biegacze.text: Bunny, Hedgehog, Duckling and Mouse are running. Bunny is the biggest, he's sure to win!

line.a_biegna.text: They're off! Let's follow them, all the way to the finish!

line.b_trzeci_ok.text: Yes, Hedgehog is third! Mouse first, Bunny second, and Hedgehog third.

line.b_slimak.text: Oh, here comes Snail, and he wants to slide too! He came last, so drag him to where he should stand.

line.b_slimak_nie.text: Oh no, no pushing in! Whoever comes last stands at the very end.

line.b_slimak_ok.text: Yes, Snail stands at the end. Now he is last in the queue.

line.b_nudno.text: What a long queue... I'm bored of waiting.

line.b_miny.text: Then let's play faces! Mole pulls a face, and you point to the same one.

line.b_miny_ok.text: Ha ha! With faces the waiting goes by fast.

line.c_srebrny_ok.text: Yes, the silver medal for Bunny, because he was second!

line.c_dom.text: You know what? At home I'll hold a race for my toys. And they'll get medals too!

line.p_drugi_ok.text: Yes! The first stands by the arrow, and right behind him the second.

line.p_ostatni_ok.text: Yes, the last one stands at the very end of the queue!

line.p_podium_ok.text: The first at the very top, the second and third beside him. That's how winners stand!

line.p_trzeci_ok.text: Yes, now Duckling stands third in the queue!

line.h_start.text: Teddy, ball and block, to the start! On your marks, get set, go!

line.h_znowu.text: Mole, again? Look who touched the finish line first.

line.h_ojej.text: Oh dear, the same as in the forest!

line.h_kto_pierwszy.text: Point to the toy that got there first.

line.h_kto_pierwszy_nie.text: That one got there later. Look who is nearest to the finish.

line.h_pilka.text: Yes, the ball is first! Small, but the fastest. The block is second, and teddy is last.

line.h_medale.text: I made paper medals! Drag each medal to the toy that won it.

line.h_medale_nie.text: That medal is for another place. Gold for the first toy, silver for the second, bronze for the third.

line.h_medale_ok.text: Gold for the ball, silver for the block, and bronze for teddy. Hooray!

line.h_ceremonia.text: A real ceremony, just like in the forest! Every toy has its medal.

line.h_zdjecia.text: I have photos from the forest race, but they all got mixed up!

line.h_zdjecia_uloz.text: Put them in order: what came first, what second, what third, and what last.

line.h_zdjecia_nie.text: Look again. What happened at the very start of the race?

line.h_zdjecia_ok.text: First the start, then the run, then the finish, and last the medals!

line.h_gra.text: And now Beaver and I race to the window! Owl is the judge.

line.h_gra_kto.text: Point to the one who reached the window first.

line.h_gra_nie.text: That one came second. Who was first?

line.h_gra_kret.text: I'm first, and Beaver is second!

line.h_gra_bobr.text: I'm first, and Mole is second!
